Reanimated Corpse

Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength, 2 bleed.

still wounded and can be burned by aggravated damage).

at "for" with the Reanimated Corpse?

this vampire should go to torpor.")

How about a Pressed Flesh Shadow Court Satyr with a Mummify?

It uses its Mummify ability, which would cause it to go to torpor, and
then wants to play Undying Tenacity (maybe to cycle). In the old days,
allies could go to torpor (and get stuck there), but then the rule was
changed so that they burn if they go to torpor. But I wonder if
Undying Tenacity kicks in first (preventing the Satyr from burning) or
whether the "burn-if-going-to-torpor" rule shortcircuits any attempt
to use Undying Tenacity.

I'd say no.

"Only usable when this vampire should go to torpor".

Even if the Corpse can play cards "as a vampire" it will be never be in a
situation where it "should go to torpor" since allies can't go to torpor.
The fact that it's considered a vampire when playing the card is moot if the
condition under which the card can be played never shows up.
